blurb: Radix UI toast primitives with viewport, actions, and close button.
description: Toast system based on Radix UI Toast primitives. Exports ToastProvider, ToastViewport (fixed bottom-right on desktop, top on mobile), Toast root, ToastAction, and ToastClose. Supports default and destructive variants.
use_when: You need a standardized toast notification system with Radix primitives.
avoid_when: For simple notifications; this is more complex than needed unless using Radix UI ecosystem.
a11y: Full Radix UI accessibility. Close button is keyboard accessible. Supports swipe-to-dismiss on touch.
